base_dir.description: Base build directory of objects; used with -b/--base-dir

dest_dir.description: Directory to rewrite base-dir into; used with -d/--dest-dir

list_file.description: File where to put list of source and header file names; used with -l/--list-file

build_id.description: If true, recompute build ID note and print ID on stdout; corresponds to -i/--build-id

build_id_seed.description: Hash seed string for build ID recomputation; used with --build-id-seed

no_recompute_build_id.description: If true, suppress build ID recomputation even if -i or --build-id-seed are given; corresponds to -n/--no-recompute-build-id
